captions.detailed: A wall-mounted bathroom air purifier featuring a slim, light grey rectangular housing with black edges, mounted on a dark rear wall bracket. The front face includes a hinged light grey cover that swings open on two dark grey revolute knuckle hinges located along its right edge. Inside the main housing, a dark grey washable filter tray is mounted on a prismatic slide at the base, designed to slide in and out vertically.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a bathroom wall-mount air purifier with a slim rectangular housing on a rear wall bracket. The front cover must open on two revolute knuckle hinges along its right edge, and a dark grey washable filter tray should slide vertically from the housing base using a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing body by modeling a hollowed rectangular box with thin walls, a rear wall bracket, and hinge knuckles. Create the front cover as a thin plate with matching hinge pins, and link it to the housing via a revolute joint. Build the filter tray as a flat rectangular plate with small cylindrical knobs, and mount it inside the housing base using a prismatic joint with vertical travel limits.
